You REALLY NEED to try the new #AICreate tools right here on your Tik Tok app!!  It's a fun way to make your own image to AI video in just minutes - and you can upload it directly to your page and then add it to your story as well!  **It's fairly simple** 1. Hit that plus (+) sign like you're going to create a post.   2. Then at the very bottom of your screen hit "Create" 3. Then at the top of the screen there's a small icon "Ai Video" - hit that. (You may have to slide the top menu bar from side to side to find the little icon.)  4. It'll bring up a box where you upload an image (just an image!)  5. Then you write an action prompt directly into a narrative box labeled "Describe your idea" Think of something you think would be fun to see.  **Be as specific as you want and use your imagination - keeping in mind that it's able to generate a 10 second video for you - so don't write a whole Hollywood script! Just a small clip. 😂** 6. Then hit "Generate" and sit back for a few minutes (it can take several minutes) or you can hit the button that will allow you to leave the process and the video will continue to be created by TikTok and your draft folder!! You'll get a very small/quick notification at the top of your screen when the video is ready... so if you miss it, just go back to your draft holder in five minutes and it should be there.   **Tik Tok will add all the sounds/music... just add your description and Post! Have fun!! #Ai #Fun #Professor #Fyp
